        for i in range(3):
            if b[i][0] == b[i][1] == b[i][2] != 0:
                return b[i][0]
            if b[0][i] == b[1][i] == b[2][i] != 0:
                return b[0][i]
        
        if b[0][0] == b[1][1] == b[2][2] != 0:
            return b[0][0]
        if b[0][2] == b[1][1] == b[2][0] != 0:

        return 0
    
    def is_full(b):
        return all(b[i][j] != 0 for i in range(3) for j in range(3))
    
    def minimax(b, is_maximizing, alpha, beta):

        if winner == 1:

            return 0

                        beta = min(beta, eval)

            return min_eval
